d: Ahsha and Sloane race against time and each other; Jelena gambles; Terrence tries to right a wrong; Jude and Zero visit Zero's past; Kyle confesses.
Chase returns with an agenda; Ahsha loses control; Derek and Kyle feel powerless; Lionel makes a desperate move; Raquel comes clean.
Devils Nation suffers a loss; Lionel's actions reverberate throughout everyone's lives; Zero searches for a face from the past; Jelena struggles with an adversary.
Derek's hiding a secret and Ahsha's world will never be the same; Sloane fights for her life; the fight for ownership of the Devils reaches a conclusion.
Sergeant Lane's home gets taken out from under him, Eli's mission to tear down the Black Hamptons brings the community together, and Bobby makes a big move to win over Peter.
Jesse leads the town's youth in protests against Eli's new development, Carolyn and Moses fight it out in the boardroom, and Sydney catches Anthony in a compromising position.

st: The Slickest Player in the Game
d: The Johnsons continue to pose a serious threat to the Brittons, and Carolyn enlists the help of her daughter-in-law to enact some salacious strategies to get one over on the new neighbors.
Karrin joins the Brittons' fancy Fourth of July party, Carolyn takes drastic action when Morgan gives Malcolm an ultimatum, and Anthony's evening with Vanessa takes a dark turn.
Denita has a change of heart, Rbel gets a break in her gospel career, Taj makes a surprise discovery on his wedding day, and the judge rules in the Caesar Jones v. First Kingdom lawsuit.
In desperate need of her next hit, gospel queen and record executive Denita Jordan reaches a career crossroads when her son Taj endorses a traumatized rising star with a risqué reputation.
Taj goes against the family and brings a reluctant Rbel to meet his mother's rival Caesar at Redeeming Records, spurring a disaster during Denita's lifetime achievement award tribute.
Denita's scheming takes a turn for the worse in the wake of Rbel's Stellar Awards performance, a key piece of evidence is introduced in Dani's murder case, and Taj gets found out.
Mary Janes allows her own housewarming to be transformed into a media event promoting GDU as a big happy family. Niecy returns to Atlanta invigorated, while Patrick becomes a mentor.
Mary Jane and Justin's relationship goes viral. An old family friend of Helen and Paul's, stirs long-forgotten memories of a love triangle that clouded the early years of their marriage.
Mary Jane and Justin's relationship is tested when their notoriety on social media leads to discoveries about Justin's past.
Word of Lee's brimming success and new girlfriend throws Mary Jane's already tenuous relationship with Justin into doubt.
After learning that Paul and Helen are getting a divorce, the Paterson family struggles to cope with the imminent changes.

A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.
